scope: Official ContractNLI splits; all pairs; every choice fitted on DEV only, no TEST feedback

candidate_scope.tfidf_logreg: label: the BGE top-8 candidate segments; evidence: every segment of the document
candidate_scope.llm_zero_shot: label and evidence: the same BGE top-8 candidate segments (cannot cite others)
candidate_scope.rule_check_model: every segment scored by the learned evidence head; label reads its own top-k (the intended pipeline)
candidate_scope.rule_check_model_top8_candidates: same weights; label top-k restricted to the BGE top-8 candidates (isolates head quality)
candidate_scope.evidence_denominators: end-to-end: all annotated evidence of the document for every system
candidate_scope.note: Candidate scopes differ between rule_check_model and the input-bearing baselines, so a full-pipeline gain is not attributable to the classifier alone; compare the top8 variant for that.

handoff_criterion.criterion: model TEST macro-F1 > TF-IDF baseline TEST macro-F1 (handoff Phase 3)
